material.title: Wise updates verification requirements for selected account features
material.bodyOriginal: Wise updated its verification guidance for selected account features. The page lists supported identity documents, affected regions and the effective date.

material.title: 中国证件注册 Wise 后如何核对账户功能
material.bodyZh: 作者记录了自己的注册时间、所在地区、证件类型、账户界面和核对步骤，并明确说明这是个人账户个案，建议同时查看 Wise 当前官方规则。

material.title: 海外账户秒开，永久稳定不风控
material.bodyZh: 付费代办海外账户，保证成功，私信领取优惠。
